lines.text: Zion says the LORD has forgotten her, but He says a mother may forget her nursing child, yet He will not forget.
The LORD has inscribed Zion on the palms of His hands, and her priests hasten back as destroyers depart.
Zion will wear the gathering crowd as jewelry, like a bride, and her land will be too small for her people.
The LORD will raise His banner to the peoples, and the nations will carry her sons, while queens will be her foster fathers.
The LORD will retrieve the captives of the mighty, save Zion's children, and be known as her Savior and Redeemer.
